milestones.title: Thesis 01 — Manuscript and methods corrections
milestones.description: Resolve scientific framing, detector definitions, dataset accounting, figures, and tables before new analysis.

milestones.title: Thesis 02 — Statistical validity and deployment thresholds
milestones.description: Correct AP terminology, paired inference, source clustering, operational metrics, and label-free thresholding.

milestones.title: Thesis 03 — Fair baselines and ETL fault fidelity
milestones.description: Evaluate domain-informed rules, categorical ML representations, robust statistics, and realistic typed injections.

milestones.title: Thesis 04 — Hybrid pipelines and detector ablations
milestones.description: Validate rules-plus-model combinations, inductive adaptations, and equal-budget tuning.

milestones.title: Thesis 05 — Temporal validity and operational cost
milestones.description: Validate chronological behavior, drift monitoring, training/inference costs, and scaling.

milestones.title: Thesis 06 — IMRaD synthesis and academic quality
milestones.description: Rewrite Results, Discussion, and Conclusion and verify bibliography and scholarly presentation.

milestones.title: Thesis 07 — Reproducibility and certified release
milestones.description: Preserve evidence lineage, close verification gaps, and produce a reproducible certified final release.

milestones.title: Thesis 08 — Optional research extensions
milestones.description: Track non-blocking follow-up research beyond the minimum defensible thesis.
